subject.title: Feature request: config option to suppress sub-agent announce

question: What public sub-agent completion-announcement control should OpenClaw support for this narrower skip case?
rationale: The missing behavior is source-proven, but the final API overlaps per-spawn skip, global config, per-channel suppression, and parent-session routing requests.

options.title: Unified announce policy
options.body: Add one opt-in policy surface that can express current behavior plus deterministic skip and remains compatible with broader routing work.

options.title: Per-spawn only
options.body: Add only a sessions_spawn skip flag and leave global/per-channel defaults for later, reducing schema blast radius but leaving repeated boilerplate.

options.title: Defer to routing design
options.body: Keep this issue parked behind the broader announceTarget/per-channel design, avoiding duplicate API surface at the cost of continued workarounds.

recommendation.title: Unified announce policy
recommendation.body: Add one opt-in policy surface that can express current behavior plus deterministic skip and remains compatible with broader routing work.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest history across sessions_spawn, subagent announce delivery, and the prior maintainer-facing review discussion.
